name: change_agent_setting
description: Save one setting of an agent the signed-in user manages (this conversation's agent unless `agent` names another one they manage), using the revision find_setting returned for the agent layer. The agent's owner checks apply.
retry_hint: call find_setting again: its current value shows whether the earlier change was saved, and a repeat with the old revision is refused

agent.description: Agent id; omit for this conversation's agent.

value.description: The complete new value: a number, true/false, one of the setting's choices, text, or {"width": N, "unit": "px"|"%"} for widths.
